editorial.blurb: A spirited homage to European beer halls where exceptional charcuterie, fresh seafood, and house-made charcuterie shine in a warm, communal setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the maitake mushroom tempura and roasted oysters with bone marrow during happy hour for excellent value, and arrive early to snag a spot at the communal wooden tables.
signatureDishes: Roasted oysters with bone marrow, breadcrumb, and lemon
